note: Battle feel: movement, handling and intensity. Every number is GAMEPLAY TUNING (GAME INVENTION). Read by the Unreal battle only; the sim core never reads it and nothing here reaches the campaign. Contract: protocol/schemas/battle_feel.yaml. Budgets are per platform: 'measured' null means that platform has not been measured and holds the lowest setting.

clear.note: A man at the trail whose muzzle would be in a friend raises it. A friend counts when he stands within distance_cm ahead along the line the trailed musket points and within half_width_cm of that line; the piece then goes up to pitch_deg at yaw_deg (the hand stays where the trail has it). Checked every check_seconds.

kneel.note: A man down behind cover (ducked) kneels: hips lowered, the right foot drawn back so the right knee goes toward the ground, the body leant a little forward. A procedural pose until a kneeling clip is dropped in.

reload.note: The loading drill's left hand. With the butt on the ground to ram, the musket's own left-hand spot (by the lock) is down at the knee, out of a standing man's reach, and the hand hung at his thigh. It now holds the barrel higher: the spot is slid toward the muzzle until it is ram_left_hand_height_cm above his feet, by no more than ram_left_hand_max_slide_cm.

traversal.note: Automatic traversal (GAME INVENTION). A man sprinting at a wall, fence or field work goes over it with no key pressed: a hurdle over something low, a vault with a hand on something chest high, a mantle onto and over something deeper or higher. Anything taller than mantle_max_height_cm, or deeper than mantle_max_depth_cm, cannot be crossed and stays cover. Heights are from the ground the man stands on; depth is through the obstacle along his run. Bots cross at links placed every bot_link_spacing_m along a crossable obstacle.

movement.note: The player's movement and camera (GAME INVENTION). Before 2026-11-15 these were constants in RFCharacter and engine defaults: acceleration 2048, braking 2048, turn rate 360, camera lag 10, still after a shot 0.6 s (DA_WeaponTuning FireStillSeconds, no longer read for this), mouse smoothing on. walk and sprint speed are unchanged.

input.note: Buffered input (GAME INVENTION). A press that cannot be acted on at once (he is held still after a shot, mid-thrust, over a wall) is remembered for its window and acted on the moment it can be; older than the window it is dropped. vault: the jump key asks for a traversal at any speed for this long.

intensity.note: How hard the battle presses on the player (GAME INVENTION). Before 2026-11-15 the near miss's 5 m and 8 m and its 2 degree start were constants in MusketProjectile, and the fallen's 24 and 45 s were console variables only (pa250.MaxCorpses, pa250.CorpseSeconds still override). The rest is new.

music.note: Layers of one piece, started together and kept in step; each layer's loudness follows how the day is going for the player's side. Intensity = morale_weight x (share of his squads not steady) + ticket_weight x (share of his reserve spent), 0 to 1. A layer is silent below `from`, full at `full`, and rises evenly between; a layer whose from and full are both 0 always plays.

suppression.note: GAME TUNING. The player's suppression, 0 to max: a near miss adds near_miss_add, a round shot or shell striking close adds impact_add (times how hard it shook him); it falls decay_per_second. At level L his view blurs by L x blur_amount (shallow focus) and his aim sways up to L x aim_sway_deg. Event driven, no traces per tick (ARFCharacter::AddSuppression / TickSuppression).

musket.note: GAME TUNING (Battle Feel M4, PA250MusketFeel). Every trigger pull, bots' and the player's: flash_in_pan_chance (the priming burns, no shot) for everyone; misfire_chance (the flint gives no spark) for a man without a training profile, the player (a bot misfires at its DA_CombatProfiles MisfireChance, stress-scaled). Either way the charge is spent and he loads again. Rain (PA250BattleWeather, -PA250Weather=rain until BattleSetup carries weather) multiplies them. Before 2026-11-16 the player never misfired.
